hypothesis: The C62 causal failure is caused by temporal-contract erasure: averaging two four-action latent groups and concatenating H3 keys at a shared temporal RoPE coordinate. Restoring one four-action group per real observation and exact H3 temporal key reindex should make correct action-observation order mechanically identifiable before any optimizer experiment.

staged_single_variable_hypotheses.single_variable: Mechanical source-contract replacement: replace 8-action two-group shared mean with exactly one four-action group per real observation and route the true sink through a learned null; do not add temporal reindex in this ablation.
staged_single_variable_hypotheses.falsification: After swapping complete post-sink observation-action pairs and undoing only the chunk permutation, K and V must be bit-exact.

staged_single_variable_hypotheses.single_variable: Apply exact H3 temporal RoPE delta rotation to already-rotated pooled K at each contiguous logical frame position; V and all spatial/tail dimensions remain unchanged.
staged_single_variable_hypotheses.falsification: After the same pair swap and chunk realignment, K must differ because the same raw frame occupies another logical position, while V remains bit-exact.

decision.rationale: The real C58/H3 mechanical gate passes and the implementation is materially more faithful than C62 on the upstream temporal contract. It still intentionally differs from MiniWorld's internal VideoDiT modulation/KV update, and cadence versus learned-null is not yet an element-level effect ablation. Do not optimize, roll out or fuse this bridge until three explicit cadence/null/RoPE arms exist; alternatively stop the external bridge and port internal pre-QKV 6D modulation.
